_about: Рисунки карточек: что нарисовано (ru) и описание для генератора картинок (en). Имя — то же, что в поле art у выборов и карточек. Страницу с готовыми запросами собирает refs/tools/build_art_page.py; он же проверяет, что описан каждый рисунок, который нужен сюжету.

g_coins.en: an open hand, palm up, holding three gold coins

g_eyes.en: a pair of big round wide-open eyes with raised eyebrows, just the eyes

g_eyes_shut.en: a pair of big round eyes squeezed tightly shut: each eye is a closed lid pressed into one thick curved line with small wrinkles at the corners, the eyebrows pulled down and together in effort, just the eyes

g_mouth.en: an open talking mouth with an empty round speech bubble coming out of it

g_sit.en: a small three-legged wooden stool, worn and a little crooked

o_wooden_phone.en: a smartphone carved from a slab of tree bark, with rounded corners, patches of moss and a crack stitched with twine. A turnip is carved into its back. In the upper corner there is one round knot hole instead of a camera. A small bark beetle sits on its edge. A turquoise glow leaks from under its side. No camera lenses, no camera block
